ANALYSIS_SETTINGS: inherited unchanged from config_v1_4.json under tag v1.4: features, fold-local statistics, fold generator (T0 rule, embargo g = 6, fold size 1), purge rule, four arms, models, seed, bootstrap, SESOI. Only the target column changes.
TARGETS_EXCLUDED: sleep quality and sleep duration (share structure with the Fitbit sleep features); readiness, fatigue and soreness (sport-load constructs) -- revision analyses memo, Task 3
TARGET_SOURCE: pmsys/wellness.csv through the W1-W4 table built in cell W-1 (config_v1_4.json WELLNESS_RULES); no wellness.csv field enters any arm's features (asserted in T3-1)
TARGET_FORM: raw next-day value, not smoothed: row s (Fitbit calendar day d_s) is scored against the W1-W4 value of local day d_s + 1
DAY_ALIGNMENT: report dated by its local Europe/Oslo calendar day (W1), the day boundary of the Fitbit daily files
PURGE: v1.4 purge rule applied with target support {s + 1}; with embargo g = 6 it removes no training row
MISSING_TARGET: test day without a next-day value: dropped from scoring, not imputed; training rows without a target: dropped from that fold's fit

ELIGIBILITY.applied_to: each target separately, on that target's values over the scored test days (the memo states the rule for mood; stress uses the same rule on stress values)

STATISTICS: as Task 1 (V12-6 functions, unchanged): mean delta rho with BCa 95% CI (10,000 resamples, seed 42); Hodges-Lehmann median with BCa 95% CI; paired Wilcoxon P; BH q across the four neutrosophic-vs-baseline comparisons within each target; TOST at +/-0.10 on the 90% CI; advantage >= 0.10 rejected if the upper 90% bound < 0.10; absolute rho per arm with BCa 95% CI and one-sample Wilcoxon vs 0. V3 vs V-signed reported without q.
ARTIFACT_BOUND: upper 95% bound of each Task 3 comparison vs the self-derived advantage computed on the SAME eligible participants (mean over them, from results_v1.4/table1_corrected_self_target_per_participant.csv; without-p12 rows: from results_v1.4/supplementary_without_p12_self_target_per_participant.csv). n/a for V3 vs V-signed (no q) -- v1.4 review memo, Section 4 item 1
COMPLETE_PAIRS: every eligible participant must have a finite rho in all four arms, so every paired test uses the same n; otherwise the run stops (v1.4 review memo, Section 4 item 2)
P12: included in the primary analysis (guide's decision, v1.4 review memo Section 1: its exclusion was a loader bug and it meets the rules fixed before any result). If p12 is eligible for a target, that target is also reported without p12 (p12 removed from the cohort and from every donor pool) as a sensitivity analysis

PERSISTENCE_REFERENCES.status: reference rows outside the BH set; fixed here before any Task 3 result (v1.4 review memo, Section 4 items 3-4)
PERSISTENCE_REFERENCES.mood_and_stress: forecast for row s = the W1-W4 value of day d_s (today's report) for the next-day value; scored on the Task 3 scored test days of the eligible participants where today's value exists; per-participant Spearman rho; mean rho with BCa 95% CI; days used; per-participant values saved
PERSISTENCE_REFERENCES.self_derived: the L2 proxy (l2_proxy_rho: forward target, fixed lambda (0.2, 0.3, 0.5), no model) recomputed for all v1.4 participants; its mean must equal the v1.4 'Clean + L2 only' value in results_v1.4/task2_one_at_a_time.csv; per-participant values saved; paired V3 vs persistence (mean delta rho, BCa 95% CI, Wilcoxon P), labelled exploratory
PERSISTENCE_REFERENCES.raw_feature: today's causal raw composite (the quantity the raw-feature target smooths) as the forecast of the raw-feature target; reference only, to show whether that target is predictable at all

L2_UNDER_FORWARD_TARGET: the self-proxy is a naive persistence forecast, not a leak (guide's decision, v1.4 review memo Section 2): Figure 4 is redrawn from the L2-removed state; Table 4 shows L2 under both targets (v1.2 trailing, v1.4 forward)
